root_cause: No TTY in CI runner; stdin consumed
local_repro_command: docker compose run app echo test  (hangs?)
fix: Add -T flag: docker compose run -T --rm app ...

symptom: Shell script variable causes unexpected split

root_cause: Missing set -euo pipefail; piped command failure ignored
fix: Add set -euo pipefail at top of every script

symptom: Docker build succeeds but app fails at runtime
fix: Use multi-stage build; copy only runtime deps

symptom: docker compose up doesn't use new image
Environment variable not set in CI
root_cause: Variable defined in .env but not in CI runner vars
fix: Add variable in GitLab CI/CD settings → Variables

root_cause: Script file not executable; container runs as root
fix: Add: RUN chmod +x script.sh; and USER appuser

symptom: Port not accessible after compose up
fix: Set host: 0.0.0.0 in service config; map ports: '8000:8000'

root_cause: curl not installed in slim image; wrong endpoint
fix: Add curl to runtime stage; verify /health endpoint exists

symptom: deploy script consumed by compose run
root_cause: Script's stdin fed to compose run
local_repro_command: ./deploy.sh (deploy.sh has docker compose run without redirect)
fix: Redirect: docker compose run -T --rm app cmd < /dev/null

symptom: Build cache invalidated on every push
root_cause: COPY . . before pip install; code change busts layer
fix: Order layers: COPY requirements.txt → RUN pip install → COPY . .

root_cause: Secret passed as ARG or RUN env
fix: Use --secret mount (BuildKit) or pass at runtime only

root_cause: No image pinning; latest tag overwritten
fix: Pin deploys to SHA: $CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA; keep last 3 tags

root_cause: Container binding to wrong interface or port
fix: Bind container to 0.0.0.0; map port; check caddy reverse_proxy target

root_cause: Missing docker login step in CI

symptom: make verify fails in CI but passes locally
fix: Pin version in CI image; match local tool version
